text.tspan: Talos + Proxmox + Tiered Storage — UniFi VLANs

g.text: TALOS CLUSTER — VLAN 30 · API VIP on VLAN 30 (same L2)
PROXMOX — TWO STANDALONE NODES (not clustered) · Mgmt on VLAN 7 · VLAN-aware bridges
STANDALONE INFRASTRUCTURE — deliberately OUTSIDE the cluster

text.tspan: stable endpoint even if one CP host is down
etcd quorum: 3 members — survives 1 host loss
Local disk only — NEVER on NFS
Runs on Gaming PC Proxmox (see below)
Why not clustered? 2 nodes can't hold clean quorum,
no shared VM disk for live migration / HA anyway.
Backups to TrueNAS are the real safety net.
5–6× 12 TB HDD · 2× 128 GB SSD boot · ZFS

g.text: * Model unconfirmed — Josh thinks DS420slim. Verify on the unit.

text.tspan: SSH · Claude Code · Codex · T3 · Hermes · OpenClaw
Only legal macOS host → Xcode / xcodebuild
for Mac & iOS apps (cannot be done from Linux)
Tailscale · no sleep · auto-start after power loss
Note: Talos does NOT boot on Apple Silicon
Must NOT depend on the cluster:
if the cluster is down, DNS still works
2012 Xeon · 32 GB DDR3 · 4× 4 TB + SSD boot
~100 W idle, approx 10-15 USD/mo — not worth 24/7
modern low-power board as 24/7 backup NAS
For now: cold-spare backup target, or retire
Spare / toy — nothing planned around it

g.text: 1. etcd + HA VM data: local disk only, never NFS
2. Talos VIP must be on VLAN 30 - same L2 as the 3 minis
3. Proxmox bridges are VLAN-aware so NFS rides VLAN 30 directly, no router hairpin
4. No Longhorn / Ceph needed - Synology SSD NFS is the fast tier
5. First next action: install the switch back into the server rack
HA lives with its IoT devices
allow home to HA port 8123 + mDNS reflector
